verification_instructions: 1. Run 'uv run pytest tests/ -v' and confirm all 129+ tests pass. 2. Verify any new audit outputs exist at expected paths.
setup_instructions: uv sync installs all dependencies from uv.lock
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.11 with uv package manager.
contribution_requirements: All code changes on branch feat/quant-research-pipeline. Maintain existing test coverage.
key_patterns: Signal functions in src/quant_research/hypotheses/signals.py take DataFrame(OHLCV+features) -> pd.Series. Hypothesis dataclass in catalog.py ties signals to metadata. HypothesisGenerator in generator.py creates all 103 hypotheses. StatisticalTester computes forward returns via shift(-forward_period) which correctly looks at future returns for backtesting. FeatureEngine uses only backward-looking windows. ORDER_FLOW_PROXY category explicitly labeled as OHLCV-derived proxies.
directory_structure: src/quant_research/ contains: data/ (fetcher.py, features.py), hypotheses/ (signals.py, generator.py, catalog.py), testing/ (statistical.py, rejection.py), validation/ (pipeline.py, walk_forward.py, out_of_sample.py), robustness/ (regime_analysis.py, transaction_costs.py), strategy/ (entries_exits.py, position_sizing.py, risk_controls.py), reporting/ (results.py), main.py. tests/ contains 5 test files with 129 tests. No results/ directory exists yet.
